title: Prepare SpecSync 6.3.0 package metadata and release handoff
description: Prepare SpecSync 6.3.0 package metadata and release handoff
no_spec_change_rationale: Release package version, the self-built candidate inputs and release documentation only; no runtime, canonical spec, published Action default, risk or provenance policy changes
acceptance_criteria: Cargo.toml and the specsync Cargo.lock entry, the CI packaged Action consumer version and the Trust specsync-version are 6.3.0; README and site Action examples pin @v6.3.0 with version '6.3.0' while the action.yml default, PUBLISHED_ACTION_DEFAULT, the Action docs default row and current-install guidance stay published 6.2.0; CHANGELOG.md has a dated 6.3.0 section listing every user-visible change merged since v6.2.0 (including #1067's relay gate entry once it merges) with the Unreleased link comparing from v6.3.0; docs/releases/6.3.0.md names the selected source, the upgrade notes (once a repository records one relayed decision, every machine that runs change commands there needs SpecSync 6.3.0 or later, while check-only uses keep working; relays on legacy workflow-v1 changes are not gated), what the release lane does, and every remaining owner gate; validate-release-version.py, validate-workflow-runtime-pins.py and test-validate-release-candidate.py pass at 6.3.0; no tag, release or publish happens
